segments.title: How much life is in ONE spoon of soil?
segments.say: One tablespoon of soil. How many living things are in it? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: More than ALL of us!
segments.say: More living things than there are people on Earth!

segments.title: 95% of our food
segments.say: And about ninety five percent of our food is produced in soil.

segments.title: World Soil Day: Dec 5
segments.say: Tomorrow is World Soil Day. Source: the UN's FAO.
